canonical.title: Weekend in Grassau anchored on dinner at ES:SENZ

siblings.title: Walking-distance lodging at or near ES:SENZ
siblings.summary: ES:SENZ is inside Das Achental Resort, so the only true zero-walk option is to sleep on-site — alternatives in Mietenkam village put you 5–15 min on foot.

siblings.title: Special-character lodging within taxi range of ES:SENZ
siblings.summary: Six character properties within a 15-minute taxi of ES:SENZ in Grassau, ranked from medieval-castle pedigree to 1604 fisherman's stone house — plus the late-ferry trick that lets you sleep on Fraueninsel.

siblings.title: Day-trips and activities within 30 km of ES:SENZ
siblings.summary: Decision-grade guide to Chiemsee islands, Chiemgau peaks, castles, towns, spas and rainy-day picks inside a 30 km radius of Das Achental, with hours, prices and distances.

siblings.title: IT conferences and tech events within 30 km of ES:SENZ
siblings.summary: The 30 km radius around ES:SENZ in Grassau covers Traunstein and Rosenheim — a small but active scene: Stellwerk18 startup center, TH Rosenheim Campus Chiemgau, ROSIK IT network, and one notable autumn event (PPC Camp at KuKo Rosenheim, Oct 29).

sources.title: Das Achental — ES:SENZ
sources.claim: ES:SENZ is the in-house three-star restaurant inside Das Achental and has multiple closed weeks across 2026 including 01.06–07.06.

sources.title: Das Achental Resort
sources.claim: Das Achental sells an es:senz Dine & Sleep package from €515 pp/night and has a 2,000 m² spa with infinity pool.

sources.title: Residenz Heinz Winkler
sources.claim: Late-medieval boutique hotel in Aschau im Chiemgau (32 rooms); Restaurant Epicures regained its Michelin star in March 2024.

sources.title: Hotel Bonnschlössl, Bernau
sources.claim: 15th-century castle (built 1477) in Bernau am Chiemsee, a 7-minute drive from the lake.

sources.title: Inselhotel zur Linde, Fraueninsel
sources.claim: Over 600 years of hospitality on Fraueninsel — one of the oldest inns in Bavaria.

sources.title: Michelin Guide — ES:SENZ
sources.claim: Three-star ES:SENZ at Mietenkamer Straße 65, 83224 Grassau; service Wed–Sat 18:30–23:00.

sources.title: Kampenwandbahn — Tickets
sources.claim: Summer 2026 round-trip €28 adult / €32 in peak season (Jul 1–Sep 14); hours 9:00–17:00.

sources.title: Schloss Hohenaschau
sources.claim: Guided tours only (May–October); adults €7, family card €15; steep 15–20 min uphill walk.

sources.title: Falknerei Burg Hohenaschau
sources.claim: 45-min raptor flight demonstrations through 18 Oct 2026 at 11:00 and 15:00; €10 adults, cash only.

sources.title: Bayerische Staatszeitung — Bernau 1100 jubilee
sources.claim: Bernau celebrates its 1,100-year jubilee in 2026 with a traditional Maibaumaufstellen featuring local Trachtler groups.

sources.title: Farmhouse 1604, Übersee
sources.claim: Listed stone fisherman's house with a 1604 foundation stone; four apartments (95–230 m²); electric-boat lake access.

sources.title: Chiemgauhof Lakeside Retreat
sources.claim: 28-suite lakeside hotel designed by Matteo Thun; member of The Leading Hotels of the World.

sources.title: Übersee — Chiemsee Schifffahrt
sources.claim: Übersee/Feldwies ferry operates 25 May to 22 September with four daily departures.

sources.title: Strandbad Übersee
sources.claim: Bavaria's longest contiguous sandy beach (5 km); 40,000 m² lido with modern Strandcafé.

sources.title: Abtei Frauenwörth
sources.claim: Benedictine convent founded 772 — oldest in Germany still in operation; Carolingian Torhalle from c.850; 45-min guided tour by a nun €6.

sources.title: Chiemsee Schifffahrt — Nachttaxi
sources.claim: After the last scheduled crossing, the night taxi runs on demand between Gstadt and Fraueninsel/Herreninsel until midnight; book +49 170 2053542 ~30 min before departure.

sources.title: PPC Camp 2026
sources.claim: Performance-marketing barcamp, 29 October 2026 at KuKo Rosenheim; Early Bird (€349) closes 4 June 2026.

sources.title: Stellwerk18 — Events
sources.claim: KI-Weißwurstfrühstück (Jun 12), STARTUP FESTIVAL (Jun 17), Geschäftskontaktemesse (Jun 25) in 2026.

sources.title: Schloss Herrenchiemsee
sources.claim: Open daily, summer 9 am–6 pm with last tour ~5 pm; access only via guided tour.

sources.title: Herrenchiemsee — Admission
sources.claim: New Palace guided tour €11 regular / €10 reduced; combined Island ticket with special exhibition €14.

sources.title: Chiemgau Thermen — Prices
sources.claim: Therme day-ticket €31, Therme+Sauna €39; weekend/holiday surcharge +€5.

sources.title: Chiemgau Thermen — overview
sources.claim: One of Europe's strongest iodine thermal springs (~35°C) drilled in 1962 at ~5,000 m depth; ~1,800 m² water surface.

sources.title: Hochfelln-Seilbahn — Summer prices
sources.claim: Summer 2026 cable car round-trip €30 adult / €15.50 child / €67 family; valid from April 25, 2026.

sources.title: Hochfelln cable car overview
sources.claim: 1,674 m summit in 15 minutes via two gondolas; one of the most beautiful viewing terraces in Chiemgau.

sources.title: Hochgern (1,748 m) hike
sources.claim: 16.2 km, 1,128 m elevation gain, ~8 hours, difficult; year-round Hochgernhaus refuge.

sources.title: Geigelstein from Schleching
sources.claim: 14.9 km, 1,225 m up, ~6h45min, moderate-to-difficult; no cable car; seasonal nature-reserve closure late March to late May.

sources.title: Hochplatte (1,587 m)
sources.claim: 13.4 km from valley, 991 m elevation, ~6h55min, difficult; surefootedness required.

sources.title: Reit im Winkl — sights
sources.claim: Heimatmuseum, a ski museum with one of Europe's biggest collections, and the Catholic Pfarrkirche St. Pankratius.

sources.title: Holzknechtmuseum Ruhpolding
sources.claim: Easter–October, Tue–Sun 10:00–17:00; €9 adults; fully accessible, bilingual.

sources.title: Kampenwandbahn overview
sources.claim: Kampenwand summit 1,669 m with three-pointed rocky backdrop; views from Berchtesgaden to Hohe Tauern.

sources.title: Chiemgau Coaster — prices
sources.claim: Open daily 10:00–18:00 June–early Nov; €6 single ride, €33 one-hour flatrate.

sources.title: Bernau — Fraueninsel
sources.claim: Nuns produce marzipan and Chiemseer Klosterlikör; island fishermen sell freshly smoked Chiemsee Renken.

sources.title: Chiemsee-Schifffahrt
sources.claim: Year-round ferries from Prien/Stock and Gstadt to Herreninsel and Fraueninsel; Prien→Herreninsel ~20 min.

sources.title: Das Achental — Getting here
sources.claim: On the outskirts of Grassau; reached via a 900 m turnoff from Bahnhofstrasse onto Mietenkamer Straße.

sources.title: Les Grandes Tables du Monde — ES:SENZ
sources.claim: ES:SENZ is a member of Les Grandes Tables du Monde — a tasting-menu, wine-paired three-star kitchen.

sources.title: Das Achental — Edip Sigl
sources.claim: Edip Sigl is the named culinary director of es:senz at Das Achental.

sources.title: Michelin Hotels — Das Achental
sources.claim: Michelin describes Das Achental as 'a perfect representative of modern-rustic Bavarian hospitality' with alpine-chic rooms.
